Issue #41 — Paginate the orders list.
Acceptance criteria: paginate(items, page, size) returns the items of page `page` (1-based) with at most `size` items; page 1 starts at the first item.

diff --git a/src/orders.py b/src/orders.py
--- a/src/orders.py
+++ b/src/orders.py
@@ -1,2 +1,7 @@
 def list_orders(store):
     return store.all()
+
+
+def paginate(items: list, page: int, size: int) -> list:
+    """Items of 1-based `page`, at most `size` of them."""
+    start = (page - 1) * size
+    return items[start : start + size]
diff --git a/tests/test_orders.py b/tests/test_orders.py
--- a/tests/test_orders.py
+++ b/tests/test_orders.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+from src.orders import paginate
+
+
+def test_first_page_starts_at_the_first_item():
+    assert paginate(list(range(10)), 1, 3) == [0, 1, 2]
+
+
+def test_second_page_holds_the_next_items():
+    assert paginate(list(range(10)), 2, 3) == [3, 4, 5]
